news.details:
Follow MrGM on YouTube and X (Twitter).
We've summarized the key points from the interview below.
Interesting Storylines to Pay Attention To
The Riverglades has a fun dynamic and interplays with Warcraft 2
The Undead Paladin stuff is near and dear to Aggrend's Heart
Hyjal can be seen from anywhere and it's really cool to finally see it

news.title: WoW: Forever Makes History with Biggest Launch Ever!
news.description: Blizzard has revealed that WoW: Forever has achieved a historic launch with the biggest launch ever!
news.details:
On X (Twitter), Blizzard posted two big milestones about the WoW: Forever launch and thanked players for playing.
BlizzardCongratulations everyone, you made HISTORY!
WoW: Forever has achieved:
🔹The biggest launch in WoW history by peak concurrent players
🔹The highest number of returning players in WoW history
This is all because of you, the players. From all of us, THANK YOU!

news.title: World First Level 60s in WoW: Forever in Less Than Three Days
news.description: The World First level 60 has been claimed in WoW: Forever. Congratulations!
news.details:
The World First level 60 has been claimed in WoW: Forever - by a group of five all leveling at the exact same time. Congratulations!
After almost 52 hours, the World First level 60 has been claimed in WoW: Forever. Congratulations to the following characters for leveling so quickly!
Jokerd Prime
Burning Speed
Cloud Bells
Lmgd Mmr
Vitochie Gofast
This team of 5 worked together to pull massive amounts of mobs and then AoE'd them down for efficient experience gains. The Paladin would pull everything, and then the mages would use Arcane Explosion to AoE them down quickly.
Everyone went to painstaking lengths to make sure the experience was as synchronized as possible - as Jokerd explained on his stream, even one experience point could make the difference between one player being left behind. The last four percent of level 59 were the most challenging, with quite a bit of extensive math…

news.details:

The Drowned City instance portal now works as intended.

Improvements to the visibility of other players across long distances.
Various NPC fixes regarding loot and spawn rate.

news.title: Upcoming Pet Changes in WoW: Forever - Upcoming Class Tuning for November 10th
news.description: The first set of class tuning adjustments has Hunter and Warlock pet changes and adjusts what stats Enhancement Shaman will want on their gear!
news.details:
Now that players around the world are leveling up in WoW: Forever, we’ve identified a few class issues that we feel need some immediate changes. Today, we’re still investigating these issues and working through them with a plan to release hotfixes on Tuesday, November 10 to address:
We’ve seen that Hunter pets and Warlock Voidwalkers are not as durable as tanks as we would like them to be. Our intent is for their effectiveness to be relatively the same as in Classic Era. We will adjust their stats as necessary to accomplish this.
Affliction Warlock reports indicate that always channeling Wrack is superior to also casting damage-over-time abilities like Siphon Life, Corruption, and Bane of Agony. We will make adjustments to make sure those are always worthwhile to cast combined with Wrack, without affecting Affliction Warlocks’ total damage output.

news.title: Raid Rewards and PvP Balance - Crix Interview on WoW: Forever
news.description: Crix interviewed Kris Zierhut and Tim Jones on WoW: Forever and discussed raid rewards, PvP balance and more!
news.details:
Check out Crix on his YouTube Channel, Twitch, and Twitter.
We've summarized the key points from the interview below.
What Success Looks Like
For Kris, he hopes that they are still pulling in and picking up new players and growing the audience of players.
A stable ecosystem of raids and PvP events to go to, but not overwhelming.
For Tim, he wants there to be many opportunies still: zones to explore, quests to do, raids to defeat.
He wants to go to places that players want to go to, but also new mysterious zones, raids and dungeons.
A key thing is that every time there is a patch with new content, they mix up the meta enough with new unsolved problems so that the best way to play is ever shifting.
They also want to add to the threads in the world that were never finished, and then add more threads to new stories.

news.title: Blizzard Fixing Issues Causing Duplicates of NPCs and Mobs
news.description: Blizzard is addressing the issue of NPCs and mobs being briefly duplicated across each layer.
news.details:
For a brief period of time, NPCs and mobs had multiple copies of themselves, creating some very dangerous areas, or many clones of the same NPC.
Blizzard posted in a server message that this is being worked on after a "blip in the multiverse".
Greetings! There was a slight blip in the multiverse. We are in the process of de-blipping all zones now.

news.title: Minimum Deposit on AH Being Reduced to 1 Copper Soon in WoW: Forever
news.description: Kris Zierhut has announced that the minimum deposit on the Auction House on WoW: Forever will be changed soon.
news.details:
When WoW: Forever launched, the minimum deposit for the Auction House had been increased to 1 Silver. This adds a lot of risk to players in the early economy, as losing 1 Silver every time you don't sell an item can quickly add up, especially when money is tight. In an interview with Crix, Kris Zierhut discusses how they handle internal disagreements. At the end of the segment, he addresses the minimum deposit change, noting that it will be changing soon.
Kris ZierhutMaybe the minimum price on the Auction House should be 1 Copper, and not 1 Silver for deposits. We were just talking about that one earlier today and after talking about it with people more, yes, we're changing it back to one copper as the minimum deposit. That's coming. Not yet, but coming.
Whenever this change is live, players will no longer need to take on a significant risk when putting items on the Auction…

news.title: Shaman Talents Revisited Early Next Year - Blizzard Addresses Shaman Classic Discord Shutdown in WoW: Forever
news.description: Blizzard has addressed the Shaman Classic Discord shutdown, noting that they are looking at revisiting Shaman talents, but no sooner than early next year.
news.details:
Elemental Shaman GuideEnhancement Shaman Guide
Earlier this week, before the WoW: Forever launch, the Shaman Classic Discord shut down in protest of "how the developers are approaching all Shaman specs in WoW Forever."
In a recent interview with Crix, Kris Zierhut addresses the shutdown and gives his thoughts on the current state of Shaman and what the future for Shamans could be.
Kris ZierhutI think some of their issues are legitimate and some of them are that they're mad they can't have improved Ghost Wolf.
Kris goes on to discuss how they're looking particularly hard at Enhancement, as they're being pushed towards wanting too much spell power gear. Enhancement Shamans should want to wear Strength, Intellect, and Spell Power, similar to Ret Paladins. They do not want Enhancement to run around in Cloth Robes.
